justifications.durability: tests/test_plan_review_rounds_keep_their_own_file.py:73 asserts first != second, which reddens when _target_path reuses the plain path, the regression the reviewed negative control reproduces (3 failed, EXIT=1).
justifications.evidence: the done-when is a prove-by-test measure; the gate at tests/test_plan_review_rounds_keep_their_own_file.py is green (25 passed, EXIT=0) with a negative control that reddens the three cases, and I re-ran the named file at 02f0134e (3 passed, EXIT=0).
justifications.fit: the added helpers follow the module's _record_/_stored_ private-helper idiom and carry no plan, sprint or ticket identifier.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/plan_review.py:505 _target_path allocates a .at-<blob8>-<review-run-tail> sibling when a different run holds the plain path or the blob sibling, so two runs of identical bytes at one version no longer share a file.
justifications.reuse: the run-owned sibling reuses the existing _candidate_paths glob (reckon/crew/plan_review.py:617) rather than adding a reader and adds no second store; the one duplication is the token sanitiser.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff --name-only 1d6e2f15..02f0134e lists only reckon/crew/plan_review.py and tests/test_plan_review_rounds_keep_their_own_file.py, exactly the declared write paths.
